purpose: Read-only attestation of the REG.RU production SSH host public keys after the protected pin stopped matching. Compare fingerprints read locally on the existing restricted pc-prod runner with three stable external ssh-keyscan observations before any release or credential change.
requiredBehavior: run production-side attestation only on the existing self-hosted pc-prod tai-readonly runner
read only public SSH host keys from /etc/ssh and derive SHA256 fingerprints
observe the canonical production endpoint from a GitHub-hosted runner three times and require byte-stable ssh-keyscan output
require every externally observed fingerprint to exist in the locally attested production host-key set
report only public key types, SHA256 public fingerprints and boolean comparison with the protected stored pin
perform no production, database, container, filesystem, network, credential or application mutation
forbiddenCapabilities: changing or printing any private key or credential
updating GitHub secrets or accepting a new host key automatically
sudo, docker mutation, service restart, deployment, database mutation or application mutation
MFA, RBAC, RLS, tenant, session or authentication weakening
acceptanceEvidence: local production runner host-key fingerprint set
three identical external scan fingerprint sets
external subset of local production authority
protected stored pin match or mismatch stated without revealing any credential
